dogecoin.text: @Thecryptomist It is not easy when big influential people control the mass. Same people back then said BTC is risky, and now buying Dogecoin. Not everyone able to filter that.

@coinbureau We live in a feel-good world. Some group of people fuel that mentality. Dogecoin is mostly supported by such people and the media. The media needs to stop giving unnecessary attention. There are so many utility problem-solving projects, media don't even know their names.
